items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Henry Morton and what’s his name? Red Dugas. Red Dugas was a drummer. Had a woman had a sporting house, and he didn’t do nothing.

ctx.x: Right there, that’s where his barber shop was. In that block was all them whore houses, sporting houses. Henry Morton and what’s his name? Red Dugas. Red Dugas was a drummer. Had a woman had a sporting house, and he didn’t do nothing. She wanted her man to rest hisself, because he was always tired. Didn’t do nothing. Red Dugas. Looked white. Could have been white, if he wanted to.
When you were a kid, did you see . . . did you ever see anything in Storyville or . . . ?
